need_profile: Weekday automated run that queries Coupa for invoices from the past seven days with status draft or new and no properly linked PO, then sends a single Slack summary to the AP SME; sends nothing on a clean day; Time-based: weekdays at 10:00 Romania time ...

projects.name: no-po-invoice-chaser-api
projects.why: single pinned project inside the solution

decisions.reason: considerations §4 is the only approved shape for external calls
